body:
CONTEXT
ROADMAP.md L114-130 (verbatim core): "The suite is black-box, so it asserts only OBSERVABLE precedence, i.e. which outcome wins when two conditions hold at once, and never the internal order of steps that have no observable difference ... The precedence pairs asserted against v2.11.0, one test each: an empty scope ends the run before a secret refusal can occur (non-loop without `--prompt-only`, and loop); a secret refusal happens before any provider is called (the mock provider records zero invocations); the review call precedes verify calls; verify precedes the derived verdict (a refuted finding does not gate); grounding uses unredacted evidence while printed output is redacted; the ledger and the printed result carry the same redacted findings. In step 0, and unchanged through C2 and C1, the secret scan covers what it covers today: the collected repository content only." Delta 17 (sequencing step 2) later "edits the two stage-order tests adjacent to the scan and adds fixtures with a token in the diff, in the focus text" (L139-141): focus-text fixtures belong to delta 17 and MUST NOT appear here; the scan-adjacent tests must be isolated and clearly named so delta 17 can edit them surgically.
A9, L832-846: the MULTI-mode stage order around the merge is v2.11.0's and pinned by a parity row: per-provider review -> per-provider verify -> per-provider assessFindings -> mergeProviderResults (uses per-provider assessments to choose each group's representative, so an ungrounded high-confidence finding never outranks a grounded one, gh-9 P5#2) -> assessFindings on the merged result -> deriveQuorumVerdict.
C5, L1074-1076: "Parity suite rows for CLI timeout, argv-too-large, unknown-flag, and generic failure pin the messages."
C2, L956-958: the parity suite pins SINGLE mode's provider-fallback lifecycle. Today: src/resolution-lifecycle.js withProviderFallback (L49-72: ONLY a cache-sourced resolution that fails isStaleResolutionFailure, L20-28, is re-detected once with the failed provider excluded) and persistAutoResolution (L34-42: writes the cache after a successful auto-detected review). Note the cache-use rule in configureLLM (src/llm.js ~L1355-1366): a cached `cli` entry is ignored when an API key outranks CLIs in the builder context (apiOutranksCliInContext L1293-1306; in the default context ANY API key outranks), and a cached cli entry also needs cliPath equal to the trusted resolved path (cachedResolutionUsable L1251-1283). C4/delta 8 later delete the cache and edit these rows.

WHY THE EMPTY-SCOPE PAIR USES AN EMPTY BRANCH COMMIT
In v2.11.0 the non-loop path checks `context.isEmpty` (bin/cli.js L322-336) BEFORE `scanForSecrets(context.content)` (L338), and the scan reads only context.content. For both conditions to hold at once, the token must be in repository content while the scope is empty. Branch scope does this: collectBranch (src/git-context.js L191-216) sets isEmpty = (fileCount 0 && diffBytes 0) but still puts the `Commit Log` section (git log of the range, including commit subjects) in `content`. A feature branch whose only commit is `git commit --allow-empty -m "add key AKIA<16 chars>"` therefore has isEmpty=true and a token in content. The branch loop has the same order (src/loop.js ~L1577 empty check, ~L1588 scan). With the order swapped (mutant AC4a) the run would refuse with exit 1, so the row can fail.

HARNESS CONTRACT (from T50): defineRows/row() with per-file manifests; failing claude/codex reviewers are invoked twice (stdin then argv retry) except unknown-flag rejections and over-argv-limit prompts; unexpected stub requests get 418; withMutant requires a unique `find`; ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_CONFIG is fresh per run unless `configPath` is passed.

Code under test (read only): bin/cli.js L318-352 (prompt, empty exit incl. --prompt-only L325-328, secret scan with the --prompt-only exception at `if (!args.promptOnly && !args.allowSecrets)`), runOneReview ~L235-248, L404-432 (scrubResult then recordFindings L418-419: ledger written from the SAME scrubbed result that is printed); recordFindings L205-216; src/findings-ledger.js toLedgerEntries L15-31 (entries are {ts, tool, file, line, category, severity, desc: finding.title}; GATING findings only); src/review.js assessFindings ~L205, verifyFindings ~L807, mergeProviderResults ~L593, deriveQuorumVerdict ~L652; src/llm.js describeUnknownFlagRejection L412-430 (matches /flags provided but not defined/ or /unknown (?:flag|option)/; checked on the claude/generic path at L1170 and L1196, and at L952, L1147; NOT on the codex path L540-575, which retries and throws 'Failed to execute codex: ...'), timeoutExceededMessage L127-132, argvTooLargeMessage L134-140, maxArgvPromptBytes L60-95, ARGV_PROMPT_CLIS L339 (agy, copilot).

ROWS (registered via row(); ids in test/parity/rows/<stem>.json)
precedence.test.mjs
  PREC-EMPTY-SECRET-NL: branch scope (`--scope branch --base main`), feature branch = one empty commit whose message contains an AKIA token; single API (`--provider anthropic`, stub); no --prompt-only, no --allow-secrets -> exit 0, stderr contains 'Nothing to review' and NOT 'Refusing to send' nor 'Possible secret'; zero provider calls. futureDeltas [1, 17].
  PREC-EMPTY-SECRET-NL-FOE: same with --fail-on-empty -> exit 1, stderr '(--fail-on-empty set)', no secret message, zero calls. futureDeltas [1, 17].
  PREC-EMPTY-SECRET-LOOP: same empty-commit branch repo under `--loop --json --loop-unsafe --scope branch --base main` (anthropic stub reviewer, codex mock fixer) -> exit 0, events loop_start, review_result{result:null}, loop_end{exitReason clean, iterations 0}, loop_summary; stderr has no secret message; zero reviewer and fixer (non-probe) calls; every line passes assertValidEvents. futureDeltas [1, 8, 17, 18, 21].
  PREC-SECRET-NOCALL-<single|multi>: AKIA token in the working-tree diff, no --allow-secrets -> exit 1, every mock records zero non-probe invocations and the stub zero requests. futureDeltas [1, 17].
  PREC-PROMPTONLY-EMPTY and PREC-PROMPTONLY-SECRET: --prompt-only prints the prompt and exits 0 on an empty working-tree scope, and on an AKIA-bearing diff (today's exception), zero calls. futureDeltas [9] for both: R1 never applies to --prompt-only (decision B1, so no 1), P0 decision T64 keeps --prompt-only warn-only (so no 17), and delta 9 changes the printed working-tree prompt.
  PREC-REVIEW-BEFORE-VERIFY: --provider claude --verify, FLAG with 2 findings -> recorded invocation order is [review, verify, verify] (isReviewPrompt/isVerifyPrompt). futureDeltas [1, 9, 15, 31].
  PREC-VERIFY-BEFORE-VERDICT: --provider claude --verify --json, one gating finding, verifier refutes it -> exit 0, JSON verdict approve, finding absent from stdout, stderr 'Verification dropped 1 finding(s)'. futureDeltas [1, 8, 9, 15, 31].
  PREC-GROUNDING-UNREDACTED: diff adds a line containing an `sk-` token; --allow-secrets --json; single API; reviewer FLAG evidence quotes that exact line -> no grounding note on stderr (pin the grounding-note substring from src/review.js, e.g. 'confidence halved'), exit 2, and stdout JSON evidence contains the masked form, not the token. PREC-GROUNDING-CONTROL: identical except evidence quotes a line not in the diff -> stderr contains the grounding note (proves the check can fail). futureDeltas [1, 8, 9, 14, 15, 16, 17, 31].
  PREC-LEDGER-EQUALS-PRINTED: single API, --json, `--findings-ledger <abs temp path outside repo>`, one GATING finding whose TITLE contains an `sk-` token -> the ledger has exactly one entry; its desc equals the printed finding's title (both masked), file/line/category/severity equal the printed finding's file/line_start/category/severity, and the raw token appears in neither the ledger file nor stdout. PREC-LEDGER-EQUALS-PRINTED-MULTI: the same with `--providers anthropic,openai --quorum 1`. futureDeltas [1, 8, 9, 14, 16, 31] (+12 for MULTI).
stage-order-multi.test.mjs
  STAGE-MULTI-VERIFY-BEFORE-MERGE: --providers anthropic,openai --verify --json --quorum 1; both reviewers report the same finding (same file/line/title); anthropic's verifier refutes it, codex's does not -> the merged finding's corroborated_by is exactly ["openai"] (confirm label form from a run). futureDeltas [1, 8, 9, 12, 14, 15, 31].
  STAGE-MULTI-GROUNDED-REPRESENTATIVE: both report the same finding group; provider A at confidence 0.95 with evidence NOT in the diff, provider B at 0.7 with evidence quoting the diff -> the emitted finding's evidence is B's. futureDeltas [1, 8, 9, 12, 14, 15, 31].
cli-errors.test.mjs (single CLI, non-loop)
  CLIERR-TIMEOUT: `--provider claude --timeout 1`, mock sleeps 10 s -> exit 1; stderr includes the timeoutExceededMessage text v2.11.0 prints (`Failed to execute local CLI agent "claude": exceeded --timeout 1s; retry with --timeout <larger>`; copy from a run); exactly 1 invocation (timeouts are not retried). futureDeltas [1, 9, 31].
  CLIERR-ARGV-TOO-LARGE: `--provider copilot` (argv delivery, ARGV_PROMPT_CLIS; NOT agy, see P0 RESOLUTIONS) with a change large enough that the prompt exceeds maxArgvPromptBytes() (Linux per-arg limit ~128 KiB; getconf is absent so the platform default applies) and `--max-bytes` raised so the diff is inlined -> exit 1 with the argvTooLargeMessage text; pin the copilot invocation count 2.11.1 produces (0 if the guard is pre-spawn). futureDeltas [1].
  CLIERR-UNKNOWN-FLAG: `--provider claude`; claude mock prints `error: unknown option '--foo'` to stderr and exits 2 -> exit 1, stderr contains `provider "claude" rejected flag "--foo"` (describeUnknownFlagRejection), exactly ONE invocation (no argv retry for a flag rejection, src/llm.js L1167-1172). futureDeltas [1, 9, 31].
  CLIERR-GENERIC: `--provider claude`; failTwice({stderr:'segfault-ish', exit:1}) -> exit 1, exactly 2 invocations, stderr contains 'segfault-ish' and the generic failure prefix v2.11.0 prints (copy from a run). futureDeltas [1, 9, 31].
fallback-lifecycle.test.mjs (auto-detected single mode: NO --provider; rows pass an explicit configPath)
  LIFECYCLE-CACHE-WRITE: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=dummy + stub, APPROVE, no other keys or CLIs -> exit 0; afterwards the config file exists and cache.default.provider === "anthropic" (key from builderContextKey, src/llm.js L1221-1226). futureDeltas [1, 8, 9, 14, 31].
  LIFECYCLE-STALE-CACHE-FALLBACK: seed configPath with a cache.default entry for the anthropic API, in exactly the shape LIFECYCLE-CACHE-WRITE produces (build it with withResolution from src/config-store.js or copy the written file); ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=dummy so cachedResolutionUsable is true; the stub answers the first anthropic request with 401 (stale per isStaleResolutionFailure; confirm the anthropic client sets err.status, else the '401'/'unauthorized' text matches AUTH_RE); only a codex mock is planted (APPROVE) and no other API keys -> stderr contains 'Cached provider "<anthropic label>" failed (stale credential or model); re-detected "<codex label>"' (pin both labels from a run); exactly one stub request and one codex invocation; exit 0; pin the cache entry left afterwards. futureDeltas [1, 8, 9, 14, 31].
  LIFECYCLE-NONSTALE-NO-FALLBACK: same seed; the stub answers 400 with body 'parity-stub: bad request' (non-retryable; confirm MODEL_RE does not match it) -> exit 1, zero codex invocations, exactly one stub request, no 'Cached provider' warning, cache entry unchanged. futureDeltas [1, 8, 9, 14, 31].

DELTA TAGS FOR v59 DELTAS (T50 registry, test/parity/helpers/deltas.mjs; tag semantics T50 item 9b): ids come from the registry T50 lands on day one (1-37, withdrawn ids rejected). Never 28 or 37: both are UNTAGGABLE (28 pins v2.11.0 behavior; J9.4 forbids any existing row listing 37), and the T50 checks reject them. 34 and 35: not for the additive loop_summary keys meta.thrash and meta.rotation:null, which are the T50 envelopes of those deltas. 36: only for a row that asserts stderr EXACTLY (equality, emptiness) on a detecting run, which must use assertStderrExact; the T50 helper throws until such a row lists 36, so the tag cannot be forgotten. Substring checks (assertStderrIncludes / assertStderrExcludes) need no 36: the one-line hint is the delta-36 envelope. 32 and 33: only if the row's invocation is one delta 32 rejects, or its pinned CLI retry timing is one delta 33 changes (none planned; T91 adds its own CLIERR-UNIT-BUDGET row). PREC-EMPTY-SECRET-LOOP ends at the initial empty-scope exit; its loop_summary gains only enveloped keys, so it lists none of 34, 35, 36. Every T53 stderr check, the CLIERR-* rows included, is a substring check (assertStderrIncludes / assertStderrExcludes), so no T53 row lists 36.

BASELINE: rows pin what release 2.11.1 emits (v2.11.0 plus the #66 status-path fix). Cited line numbers are approximate; locate code by symbol. Cite the ROADMAP by section heading. Rows use the T50 harness under its approved spec (.adlc/specs/T50.md): defineRows, captures that include prompts and requests (AP1), tag rules 9b/AP3 including the payload-delta rules (9 on working-tree rows that reach a provider and on working-tree --prompt-only rows; 14 on rows with stub requests; 31 on rows that reach any provider, never on --prompt-only rows; 29 on --input --verify rows), assertValidOutput/assertValidEvents from T51, and manifest entries { roadmapRef, futureDeltas }.

P0 RESOLUTIONS (verified against 2.11.1, 2026-10-07)
- Pair 1 (empty scope vs secret): on a branch-scope run whose only change is an empty commit with a token-shaped message, 2.11.1 exits 0 with "Nothing to review" and prints NO "Possible secret" line, because the empty-scope exit (bin/cli.js `if (context.isEmpty)`) runs before scanForSecrets. The row pins exactly that: exit 0, stderr contains "Nothing to review", stderr contains no "Possible secret", zero provider calls. It does not claim the commit message is scanned.
- LIFECYCLE-* rows pin today's fallback, which applies only to cache-sourced resolutions (withProviderFallback rethrows unless config._fromCache). They are the step-0 rails that T80 rewrites for delta 8 (C4).
- CLIERR-ARGV-TOO-LARGE uses COPILOT (`--provider copilot`, argv-only delivery per ARGV_PROMPT_CLIS), NOT agy. Delta 38 (T117) changes agy's over-limit path, and delta 38 is untaggable on the premise that no existing row changes, so an agy row would break that premise.
- PREC-PROMPTONLY-SECRET pins that --prompt-only warns ("Possible secret ...") and still prints the prompt with exit 0 (bin/cli.js refuses only when !args.promptOnly). P0 decision T64 keeps this, so the row lists no 17.

TAG RULE NOTE: the per-row futureDeltas above already include the payload deltas (9, 14, 31) by the BASELINE rule. A row 'reaches a provider' when it makes at least one non-probe mock invocation or stub request, so rows with zero calls (PREC-EMPTY-SECRET-*, PREC-SECRET-NOCALL-*, CLIERR-ARGV-TOO-LARGE) carry none. AC1's 'futureDeltas listed' means these final lists.

P1 SPEC: .adlc/specs/T53.md is binding and extends these ACs (AP1-AP11 and R1-R8): stage-order invariant, a leak sweep over files/env/encodings, token proof rows, mock-side sequencing, grounding asserted through the gating outcome, an exact masked ledger title, both provider orders, MSG/COUNT rows split by file (cli-errors-counts.test.mjs is a rail for T108), a 4 MiB argv fixture, NEG mutants proving a named failure plus a RAN marker, and LIFECYCLE rows seeded from a committed 2.11.1 fixture.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
AC1  Every row above is registered via row() and present in its manifest with the futureDeltas listed. Verified by the T50 registry hooks and `node --test test/parity/harness.test.mjs`, plus a test in cli-errors.test.mjs asserting that no row in the four T53 manifests lists 28, 34, 35, 36 or 37 and that none of the four files calls assertStderrExact (source scan). Negative controls: the same assertion function reports an injected manifest row listing 36, and the source scanner reports a fixture string containing `assertStderrExact(`.
AC2  All rows pass on unmodified v2.11.0. Verified by `node --test test/parity/precedence.test.mjs test/parity/stage-order-multi.test.mjs test/parity/cli-errors.test.mjs test/parity/fallback-lifecycle.test.mjs`.
AC3  Each of the six L120-130 precedence pairs has exactly one dedicated row (the loop half of pair 1 is PREC-EMPTY-SECRET-LOOP); none asserts an unobservable internal order (L116-120); no row puts a token in --focus text. Verified by AC2, `grep -c -- '--focus' test/parity/precedence.test.mjs` returning 0, and P5 review against L114-130.
AC4  Mutant negative controls (withMutant, unique finds; each asserts the targeted row FAILS): (a) bin/cli.js: move the block starting `// Secret scan: the payload leaves the machine` through the end of the secret-refusal `if` to just before `if (context.isEmpty) {` -> PREC-EMPTY-SECRET-NL fails (exit 1 with 'Refusing to send'); (b) bin/cli.js: find `  result = scrubResult(result);\n  recordFindings(args, result, assessments);\n\n  // 5. Emit output.` replace `  recordFindings(args, result, assessments);\n  result = scrubResult(result);\n\n  // 5. Emit output.` (ledger gets the unmasked title) -> PREC-LEDGER-EQUALS-PRINTED fails; (c) src/review.js: make verifyFindings return its input result unchanged -> PREC-VERIFY-BEFORE-VERDICT fails; (d) bin/cli.js runMultiProvider: skip the per-provider verify loop -> STAGE-MULTI-VERIFY-BEFORE-MERGE fails; (e) src/llm.js: make describeUnknownFlagRejection return null -> CLIERR-UNKNOWN-FLAG fails; (f) src/resolution-lifecycle.js: in withProviderFallback replace `if (!config._fromCache || !isStaleResolutionFailure(err)) throw err;` with `throw err;` -> LIFECYCLE-STALE-CACHE-FALLBACK fails. Verified in `[row:NEG-PREC-*]`, `[row:NEG-STAGE-*]`, `[row:NEG-CLIERR-*]`, `[row:NEG-LIFECYCLE-*]` rows.
AC5  Output schema: every --json row in these four files calls assertValidOutput on non-empty stdout (and PREC-EMPTY-SECRET-LOOP calls assertValidEvents on every line). Verified by AC2 plus `grep -c assertValidOutput` non-zero for precedence.test.mjs and stage-order-multi.test.mjs (L1235-1236).
AC6  CLI error rows and lifecycle warnings pin message substrings copied from a v2.11.0 run, not invented; the PR description lists each pinned string with the src line producing it. Verified by AC2 and P5 behavior-diff review.
AC7  Fallback rows leave the developer's real config untouched: the test records os.homedir()/.config/adversarial-review/config.json mtime (if present) before and after and asserts it is unchanged. Verified in fallback-lifecycle.test.mjs.
AC8  No production or rail change: `git diff --exit-code HEAD -- bin src schema.json output-schema.json loop-events-schema.json test/parity/helpers test/parity/harness.test.mjs test/parity/schemas.test.mjs` empty. Verified by that command and rails-guard.

NON-GOALS
- No delta behavior (delta 17 full-prompt/focus scan, delta 15 verify payload, delta 16 sink redaction, delta 8 no-cache are NOT tested here; their changes edit these rows).
- No loop rows other than PREC-EMPTY-SECRET-LOOP (T54).

VERIFICATION COMMAND
node --test test/parity/*.test.mjs && npm test && git diff --exit-code HEAD -- bin src schema.json output-schema.json loop-events-schema.json test/parity/helpers
title: Parity rows: observable stage-order precedence pairs, MULTI merge order, CLI error messages, and provider-fallback lifecycle (ROADMAP step 0)
